name: yt-dlp
description: Download YouTube videos, thumbnails, and subtitles with yt-dlp, transcode anything not natively Apple TV-compatible to HEVC/AAC MP4, and optionally sync the result to a remote media server over rsync/SSH with a Jellyfin library refresh. Use this skill whenever the user wants to download a YouTube video, grab a video's thumbnail, or asks to "/ytdlp" a URL. All remote-sync and Jellyfin settings are optional and configured per-machine via environment variables — with no configuration at all, it just downloads to a local folder.
